verifier_commands.name: pyright
verifier_commands._note: pyright is on PATH via `npm install -g pyright`.

verifier_commands.name: pytest
verifier_commands._note: Uses `python3.11 -m pytest` rather than `pytest` directly because pytest's entry point is installed in ~/Library/Python/3.11/bin/ which is not on the default macOS PATH. The `-m` form sidesteps PATH and pins the Python version. Test file is `test_solution.py`; agent must emit it alongside solution.py, or the testkit harness copies it in (Phase-1.75).

all-verifier-commands-pass.description: All configured verifier commands exit 0. For Phase-1.5 Python: pyright clean + pytest 0 failures (test_solution.py must exist; pytest exits 5 = 'no tests collected', which fails the predicate by design).
